_comment: Scrubbed Portrait — Marek Blacknet's farewell gift (Safari Zone, a20). The trophy hunter's off-ledger cart held a Company-scrubbed portrait of the founder; complete his horned-champion deal (monturnin heracross|pinsir -> marek_gifted) and his farewell button hands it over before the pack-out sweep despawns him. A painting the player can actually hang — the amnesiac protagonist's own face, unexplained. Nameplate/lore ship shape copied from rezoning_memo.

lore.text: The plate under the frame has been filed smooth.
